task: Make CheckoutPage load the buyer order summary via the RPC layer

findings.title: CheckoutPage reads orders directly via supabase.from
findings.rationale: Direct table access bypasses RLS/RPC; a buyer could read order rows the policy is meant to scope.
findings.fix: Replace supabase.from('orders')... with the get_buyer_order_summary RPC in services/accountApi.ts.

findings.title: Confirm button is a raw <button>, not the UI primitive
findings.rationale: Skips the editorial theme tokens and focus styles the Button primitive provides.
findings.fix: Use Button from components/UI.tsx instead of the inline <button>.
